text: Welcome to the example club. The club meets every Thursday evening in room 2.10 and new members can join at any meeting.
Membership fee: members pay 50,000 VND per semester. The treasurer collects the fee in the first two weeks of the semester.
Board elections are held once a year in March. Every member who has paid the fee may vote and may stand for a board role.
A candidate submits a one-page statement to the secretary at least one week before the election.
The annual hackathon runs for 24 hours in October. Teams have three to five members and register through the club form.
Workshop budget: each workshop may spend up to 2,000,000 VND on food and materials, approved by the treasurer before the event.
Receipts for workshop spending go to the treasurer within three days after the event.
